cohort: 67 women diagnosed with CAD at one hospital in Santiago, Chile, between July 2018 and October 2020, including 10 women in the postpartum period.
finding: This case series highlights the occurrence of CAD in the postpartum period, emphasizing that it is not limited to women with vaginal delivery and suggesting alternative causes beyond acute hemodynamic stress.
mod_finding: While the study describes cases of CAD after both cesarean and vaginal delivery, it does not draw specific conclusions about the relative risks associated with each mode of delivery.
